abstract: During sexual reproduction in plants, embryos typically develop from egg cells after fertilization, whereas synergids are crucial for pollen tube reception to deliver the sperm. A new study demonstrates occasional autonomous embryogenesis from unfertilized synergids after egg cell collapse in female gametophytes.
